name: Canada (federal + Ontario)
kernel_gaps: Credit.phaseIn has no earnings threshold (CWB: 27 % of working income above $3,000): written locally
family benefits on family income with per-child amounts and two-band reductions (CCB, OCB, GST/HST credit, OSTC): written locally
stepped premium with capped phase-ins (Ontario Health Premium, OTA s. 24(2)): plain Int function
tax reduction defined as twice an amount less the tax (OTA s. 20): plain Int function
money in cents: the kernel Out carries whole units, so cents go in detail (*Cents)
contributions with an exemption below the base and two ceilings (CPP base + CPP2): composed from Schedule.flatAbove-like logic locally

headline: Canada's 2025 tax lines match the OECD to the cent and CRA payroll within $1; the stacked benefit withdrawals of an Ontario family push METRs to 91 % (two children) and just over 100 % (four) at about $48,500, which also makes bunching income across years worth up to $10,147 for a family with children; the Ontario Health Premium form omits the split income the Act added in 2023.
